name: Agent Tool - Design Studio
description: Agent design studio: new design, edit an existing design by feedback (image edit), or full redesign; saves each version in designs + media and returns approve/edit/redesign buttons.

parameters.query: SELECT coalesce((SELECT encode(m.data, 'base64') FROM designs d JOIN media m ON m.id = d.media_id WHERE d.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::int), '') AS b64, (SELECT d.package_id FROM designs d WHERE d.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::int) AS base_package_id, (SELECT d.brief FROM designs d WHERE d.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::int) AS base_brief

WITH m AS (INSERT INTO media (mime, name, data, source) SELECT 'image/png', $1::text, decode($2::text, 'base64'), 'agent_design' WHERE $2::text <> '' RETURNING id, k), d AS (INSERT INTO designs (package_id, parent_id, mode, brief, prompt, feedback, media_id, url) SELECT NULLIF($3::text, '')::int, NULLIF($4::text, '')::int, $5::text, NULLIF($6::text, ''), $7::text, NULLIF($8::text, ''), m.id, 'https://almutawabh.com/webhook/media?id=' || m.id || '&k=' || m.k FROM m RETURNING id, url, package_id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM d) AS design_id, (SELECT url FROM d) AS url, (SELECT package_id FROM d) AS package_id, $9::text AS error

SELECT coalesce((SELECT encode(m.data, 'base64') FROM designs d JOIN media m ON m.id = d.media_id WHERE d.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::int), '') AS b64, (SELECT d.package_id FROM designs d WHERE d.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::int) AS base_package_id, (SELECT d.brief FROM designs d WHERE d.id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::int) AS base_brief

WITH m AS (INSERT INTO media (mime, name, data, source) SELECT 'image/png', $1::text, decode($2::text, 'base64'), 'agent_design' WHERE $2::text <> '' RETURNING id, k), d AS (INSERT INTO designs (package_id, parent_id, mode, brief, prompt, feedback, media_id, url) SELECT NULLIF($3::text, '')::int, NULLIF($4::text, '')::int, $5::text, NULLIF($6::text, ''), $7::text, NULLIF($8::text, ''), m.id, 'https://almutawabh.com/webhook/media?id=' || m.id || '&k=' || m.k FROM m RETURNING id, url, package_id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM d) AS design_id, (SELECT url FROM d) AS url, (SELECT package_id FROM d) AS package_id, $9::text AS error
